metadata.mathematical_interpretation_note: For nonzero fixed lambda, S = (QQ^T + lambda(QR^T - RQ^T))/sqrt(28) can theoretically absorb lambda into W'_R = lambda W_R. Observed differences reflect initialization scale, gradient scaling, AdamW/weight-decay interaction, and finite-horizon optimization dynamics rather than intrinsic model capacity.
